_comment: T-411 RARE 'champion' spawn for the Ashmoor street tier (Era-2, L20-40). Rides the T-294 elite chassis + the existing spawn/respawn machinery: it is an ordinary spawns.json entry given a low spawn_chance + a long respawn_ticks, so after it is put down it stays gone for a variable-ratio (geometric) number of dwells — the unpredictable positive spike the fun-audit asked for on top of the flat kill-treadmill. It reuses the Legbreaker silhouette (render_kind) — no new mesh/rig. Its boosted xp is the burst; the shilling purse is the coin bonus. It grants XP through the SAME server-observed kill-credit path as any mob (mob_xp.gd), so the gray-mob cutoff (T-358) and rested interaction (T-360) apply automatically and no client verb can assert it. 'rare': true is read ONLY by tools/xp_ledger.py, which EXCLUDES rares from the flat-grind average so adding this mob does not perturb the band's closed budget (the burst XP is redistributed, not added).
name: Silas Vane, the Ledger King
